description: Action-facing, chain-neutral data-sufficiency gate for an intended swap, borrow, lend, liquidation, or repay. It composes Insight’s strict multi-oracle pre-trade assessment with an optional fresh venue-quote assessment into ALLOW / CAUTION / BLOCK, lists the exact missing evidence, and returns the underlying signed assessment when available. It evaluates data sufficiency only — never contract safety, custody, profitability, or transaction execution. Monad is a first-class profile using on-chain Pyth Core evidence; set targetProviders to ["pyth"] for a low-latency native snapshot, which remains CAUTION under the strict quorum policy until independent evidence is present. Other supported chains use their configured oracle adapters.

asset.description: Asset symbol being traded, e.g. BTC, ETH, USDC

chainId.description: Chain ID where the trade executes, e.g. 1=Ethereum, 42161=Arbitrum, 8453=Base. Use 0 for chain-agnostic.

decisionInput.description: Optional fresh venue quote and explicit limits. This evidence is required for an ALLOW result; without it a healthy oracle result remains CAUTION.

reviewedAerodromeSlipstream.description: Optional strict reviewed-pool lane. Only WETH/USDC on Base through the reviewed Aerodrome Slipstream CL100 pool is admitted; unsupported routes fail closed.

amountIn.description: Exact WETH amount for the reviewed Base Aerodrome Slipstream WETH/USDC CL100 quote

reviewedUniswapV3.description: Optional strict reviewed-pool lane. Admits Monad MON/WMON→USDC and Base ETH/WETH→USDC through Uniswap V3, plus Base USDC→USDT through PancakeSwap V3; only the reviewed forward directions are admitted and all other routes fail closed.

amountIn.description: Exact source-token amount for the reviewed concentrated-liquidity quote

destinationAsset.description: Optional destination asset for the intended route

protocolId.description: Optional protocol identifier for lending actions

targetProviders.description: Optional: restrict the check to specific oracle providers

tokenAddress.description: Optional 20-byte EVM token address for advisory token-security evidence

name: execution_preflight
